Repair fp<->cat joins where PRD missed a POI-triggered divide split

Source: R/repairs.R
repair_split_divides_at_pois.Rd

After resolve_disjoint_flowpath_divides clears bogus fp<->cat joins, a small class of legitimate flowpaths is left with has_divide = FALSE even though their LINE sits entirely inside the downstream neighbour's cat on the same NHD base. Pattern: upstream half (.1) of a split NHD, with a POI at its outlet: PRD should have carved a new divide boundary at that POI but the full divide ended up with the downstream half.

This pass re-runs the raster-based splitter (split_divides_d8) for just those cases, using the POI location (= fp_up outlet = fp_down inlet) as the split point. Upstream piece becomes fp_up's new cat; downstream piece replaces fp_down's existing cat.

Usage

repair_split_divides_at_pois(
  input_gpkg,
  flowpath_layer = "flowpaths",
  divides_layer = "divides",
  pois_layer = "pois",
  network_layer = "network",
  fdr_path,
  fac_path,
  fallback_fdr_path = NULL,
  fallback_fac_path = NULL,
  coverage_threshold = 0.9,
  num_workers = 4L
)

Arguments

input_gpkg

Path to the pre-ngen GeoPackage (layers: flowpaths, divides, pois; optional: network).

flowpath_layer

Name of the flowpaths layer in input_gpkg. Default "flowpaths".

divides_layer

Name of the divides layer in input_gpkg. Default "divides".

pois_layer

Name of the POIs layer in input_gpkg. Default "pois".

network_layer

Name of the network layer in input_gpkg. Default "network".

fdr_path, fac_path

Paths to FDR / FAC rasters (same files PRD used earlier in the pipeline).

fallback_fdr_path, fallback_fac_path

Optional paths to a fallback FDR/FAC pair. When a split attempt returns NULL with the primary rasters (split point lands on NoData), the splitter is retried with the fallback. NULL disables the retry (default). Ignored when equal to the primary paths (path equality check, same as add_flowlines).

coverage_threshold

Minimum fraction of fp_up's line that must sit inside fp_down's cat for the pair to qualify. Default 0.9.

num_workers

Parallel workers for the splitter. Default 4.

Value

Invisibly, a data.frame of repaired {fp_up, fp_down, new_cat, area_km2} rows.
